basic_info.description: Spacious and bright 1 private bedroom about 187 SQFT with 2 bathrooms shared with 3 other roommates for rent, at a very affordable price $1,000/month. Coin operated washer and dryer are in the garage. Super convenient location, easy access to public transportation, there are muni 29 , 8X, 43, 49 and K car.It is in close proximity to the popular supermarkets dog parks, and Stonestown Galleria. Embrace the charm of convenient, upscale living at its finest!
